title: He Giveth More Grace
lyrics_original: Ere the day is half done,
When we reach the end of

bible_verses.english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
Not only so, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance;
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You that Your grace is always greater than the weight of my struggles. When my labors increase and my strength feels small, remind me that Your love has no limit and Your power has no boundary. I surrender my burdens to You today, trusting Your promise of multiplied peace and sufficient grace. Fill my heart with quiet confidence in Your faithful care. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life demands more of us than we feel capable of giving, this beloved hymn reminds us that God's resources are never exhausted. As our burdens increase, His supply of grace, mercy, and strength overflows to meet us in the exact measure of our need. We are invited to stop relying on our limited capacity and instead lean fully into His limitless love. Today, bring your heaviest labors to Him, trusting that His peace will multiply right alongside your greatest trials.
